wisey.title: Wisey

replies.backlog: Soon I'll create the backlog item and estimate it for you. For now I'm a preview: you can do it from Backlog › New idea.
replies.ticket: Soon I'll start the work on a ticket and tell you when the plan is ready to approve. For now I'm a preview: open the ticket from Projects and start it from there.
replies.pr: Soon I'll tell you which pull requests are waiting for a merge. For now I'm a preview: each project's page shows what's waiting on you.
replies.mail: Soon I'll tell you what's worth reading in your mail. For now I'm a preview: it's all in the Mailbox tab.
replies.inbox: Soon I'll tell you what's waiting for your decision. For now I'm a preview: it's all in the Inbox tab.
replies.status: Soon I'll tell you how a project is doing in a couple of lines. For now I'm a preview: open it from Projects to see what's moving and what's stuck.
replies.greeting: Hi, I'm Wisey. I'm a preview for now: I can't read your projects yet, but soon you'll be able to ask me about them — or ask me to do things.
replies.generic: I'm a preview for now, so I can't answer that yet. Soon I'll read your projects, tickets and mail, and act on them when you ask.

wisey.placeholder: Ask or ask me to do…
wisey.welcome: I'm Wisey. Soon you'll ask me anything about your projects — or ask me to do it. For now I'm a preview: I'll tell you what I'm going to do.
